title: Big Fibonacci with a Loop
statement: The Fibonacci numbers start with F(0) = 0 and F(1) = 1. After that, each number is the sum of the two numbers before it: F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2). Given n, print F(n) modulo 1000000007. Modulo means the remainder after division. The numbers grow very fast, so take the remainder at every step.
inputFormat: One line with one integer n.
constraints: Plain recursion is too slow. Use a loop.
explanations: Start with 0 and 1. Add the last two numbers ten times. Keep only the remainder each time. The first number of the pair is F(10).
Same loop with n = 7. The values are small, so the remainder does not change them. Print F(7).
reference:
n = int(input())
M = 1000000007
a, b = 0, 1
for _ in range(n):
    a, b = b, (a + b) % M
print(a % M)
